intervals.note: Year precision. BEPC first collided on 16 October 1988; BES published its first physics paper (the tau mass) in March 1992 (IHEP history page).
intervals.quote: BESI operated from 1989 until 1995, when it was upgraded to BESII, and BEPC was also upgraded.
